verdict.rationale: LM Studio's own docs say it serves local models on OpenAI-like endpoints "locally and on the network," and the 0.3.0 release adds a toggle that opens the server to requests from outside localhost. The `lms server start` CLI and the headless llmster daemon back this up for server use. One community user could not work out how to use it over the network, which points to poor discoverability rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: detailed network-serving configuration docs (bind address, port, authentication or access control), and independent hands-on confirmation of access from another device.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can serve models over my local network for access from other devices

citations.quote: Serve local models on OpenAI-like endpoints, locally and on the network
Turning this on will open up the server to requests outside of 'localhost'.
Start and stop the local server ... lms server start / lms server stop
